Renewable Energy Solution Engineer – Customer & Sales Focus

( PV, BESS, Data Centers, EV, Network)

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark ( DANISH SPEAKING )

Employment: Permanent

Start: ASAP

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Solution Engineer to support technical projects within Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Data Centers, EV Charging Networks and Power Distribution Networks across the Nordic region.

The role combines technical solution implementation, system integration, testing, verification and project delivery with customer engagement, partner collaboration and commercial sales support.

Responsibilities

• Take responsibility for system integration, implementation, testing, verification and project acceptance

• Support technical solution design, including platform deployment and integration verification

• Support business and system surveys for industry solution projects

• Coordinate solution implementation with customers, partners and technical teams

• Support project bidding, service solutions and sales activities across the Nordic region

• Collaborate with headquarters and Nordic teams on service solutions and sales strategies

• Support service operations, customer experience and training of service partners

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in engineering or technology

• More than 3 years of experience in the renewable energy or data center industry

• Experience in solution design, service architecture design, delivery implementation or service integration

• Experience in project support and management

• Basic service or operational experience

• Strong customer relationship skills, commercial awareness and sales awareness

• Good communication and presentation skills

• Fluent Danish and English

• Partner relationship experience and a project management background are preferred

Technical knowledge

General renewable energy industry knowledge and basic product knowledge in at least one of the following areas:

• Solar PV

• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

• Data Centers

• EV Charging Networks

• Power Distribution Networks

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We are rapidly growing, so we are looking for an additional engineer to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

Our NPI team is organized in Product Engineering within Engineering. NPI bridges the gap between product development and volume production, being the place where prototypes and first sales units are manufactured and tested.

NPI is working closely together with development engineers (optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers) for maturing the product, but also with automation engineers on manufacturing processes.

When a product has proven it can be manufactured with satisfactory yield and volume justifies, it will be transferred to our Operations department, freeing up space and resources for the new next thing.

In NPI we have a team of highly skilled technicians and engineers. Our technicians are the crank as they are manufacturing by far the most prototypes and sales units.

As NPI Engineer you will:

• Mastering and improving existing production processes – training, and supporting technicians.

• Troubleshooting issues, performing failure analysis, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

• Analyzing test and manufacturing data to identify and implement improvements in quality and productivity.

• Collaborating with Operations and other departments to transfer mature products and processes into production.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering. You have a strong affinity for processes and enjoy enabling others to follow them accurately.

Additionally, you bring:

• Experience with complex technical systems (e.g., optical fibers, free space optics, or electronic test setups).

• A proactive and process-driven mindset.

• A few years of experience from a manufacturing environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English. Being able to speak Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• You thrive in an environment where technical challenges and deadlines are part of everyday life. You enjoy teamwork – asking for help when needed and supporting colleagues when possible.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

As Safety Surveillance Principal Process Specialist, you will keep Safety Surveillance ready for every audit and inspection, and make sure the way we monitor safety information keeps pace with legislation. You will be a highly visible process expert: leading our contribution to inspections, co-driving regulatory surveillance and shaping how we integrate processes after acquisitions. Your work keeps surveillance of Novo’s marketed and developmental products compliant, simpler and focused on the work that adds most value.

What you’ll bring

You know drug safety from the inside, and you know what it takes to get an organisation ready for an inspection. You will also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, such as Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Science or Biology, or a related field.

• At least 5–7 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, including supporting safety activities in clinical trials.

• Hands-on experience facilitating inspection set-ups, training colleagues and preparing an organisation for audits and inspections.

• Expertise in Safety Surveillance processes and an enterprise mindset: you understand the end-to-end process and can turn complex internal and external requirements into practical ways of working.

• A solid background in handling deviations and implementing process changes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior internal stakeholders and external parties, and a collaborative mindset across functions and geographies.

• Resilience and a calm demeanour in a very busy environment, with the ability to multitask and prioritise your workload through complexity and challenge.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience in process management and project management.

What you’ll do

You will be a recognised expert in key Safety Surveillance processes, helping the team work with greater simplicity and focus. The role covers a diverse range of tasks, and you could be part of an inspection from day one.

• Lead audits and inspections: coordinate Safety Surveillance contributions, prepare colleagues for interviews, ensure high-quality responses and keep oversight of findings and the associated corrective and preventive actions.

• Act as Process Expert for the signal management process and co-drive the Regulatory Surveillance process, ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

• Handle deviations and change requests in close collaboration with colleagues in Safety Surveillance and other relevant functions.

• Support integration and acquisition activities by helping integrate pharmacovigilance processes and systems following company or product acquisitions and mergers.

• Contribute to process improvement projects aligned with our strategic objectives, using your end-to-end view of Safety Surveillance.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise, a team of five engaged and skilled colleagues within Safety Surveillance, and report to the Director of Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise.

Safety Surveillance is a department within Global Patient Safety in Research & Development, with departments in Bangalore, India, and Boston, US. Together, we are globally accountable for surveillance of all safety information for Novo’s marketed products and products in development. We also handle safety label updates, Risk Management Plans and aggregate reports.

You will work closely with colleagues across Safety Surveillance and partner with Global Patient Safety, other headquarters functions and affiliates during audits and inspections. When processes need to change, you will bring the right people together, create clarity on what needs to happen and help the team move forward with pace.

What you can expect here

You will have real visibility as a process expert, and the opportunity to influence how Safety Surveillance works and make a lasting impact. You will be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard, and supported by colleagues who give honest feedback and never compromise on patient safety or quality.

The pace is high and the work is varied. Through process improvement projects and a broad range of tasks, you will build new skills and deepen your understanding of safety surveillance end to end.

1,245,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning is responsible for coordinating end-to-end supply planning and execution for assigned products across Genmab’s global commercial supply chains, ensuring reliable and compliant product supply to markets.

Working closely with CMOs and internal cross-functional stakeholders, the Manager maintains up-to-date supply plans and coordinates operational planning and execution processes. The role ensures transparency of batch status, supply priorities, responsibilities, and risks, with timely follow-up and escalation to support supply continuity in a global, GxP-regulated environment. The role also collaborates with Clinical Supply to support alignment across commercial and clinical supply needs.

You will be joining the Corporate Supply Chain Planning team, reporting to the Senior Director. The team is responsible for Genmab’s global supply chain planning activities and supports Genmab’s mission to transform patient lives through innovative antibody medicines.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning you will be responsible for planning and executing supply chain activities across commercial programs, for an assigned product/product group or supply chain, ensuring alignment between demand, manufacturing, and distribution.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Coordinate operational planning and execution processes across Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Life Cycle Management, Logistics, and CMOs for assigned products, ensuring supply plans remain up to date and that batch status, priorities, responsibilities, and risks are transparent across functions

• Facilitate daily operational meetings to coordinate activities, track agreed actions, and escalate issues impacting supply through established governance

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Ensure GxP compliance across the supply chain in collaboration with Quality Assurance, including deviation handling, root cause analysis, and CAPA implementation

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field

• +6 years of experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or a related function

• Experience within biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GxP-regulated industries is preferred

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA) and supply planning tools

• Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and forecasting (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar tools)

• Familiarity with global supply chain operations and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is an advantage

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Solid written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

• Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite

• Understanding of GMP/GDP requirements within regulated supply chains

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK584.000,00---876.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Your impact begins here

Would you like to drive and lead our digital transformation journey in Finance & Operations and be the leader of the programme management office (PMO) in one of our greatest digital programmes?

In this role, you will lead a PMO team of specialists and senior managers, setting direction and driving progress across a complex global programme portfolio. By turning ambitious plans into lasting business impact, you will help build a robust and future-proof digital backbone that supports Novo’s growth.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for an established Director-level leader with the experience, presence and judgement to operate effectively in a complex stakeholder environment. You are comfortable taking significant accountability, bringing senior leaders together around shared priorities and creating clarity when competing interests and dependencies need to be balanced.

You bring:

• Strong business and technology acumen, enabling you to connect strategic business priorities with IT capabilities and influence stakeholders across both domains.

• Established leadership experience of 8-10 years, including leading and developing experienced professionals and managers, setting direction and creating the conditions for strong performance.

• Superior cost controlling capabilities as you are responsible for the budget and associated cost allocation for one of Novos digital programmes with highest investment

• A strong track record in programme or portfolio leadership, with accountability across areas such as scope, financials, schedules, dependencies and risk.

• Experience navigating a complex senior stakeholder landscape, with the credibility to challenge constructively, influence decisions and create alignment across functions.

• Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, combined with the ability to move confidently between programme-level detail and broader organisational priorities.

• A structured and proactive leadership approach, with the ability to establish priorities, maintain momentum and create accountability in a complex transformation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with confidence engaging across functions, seniority levels and geographies.

What you’ll do

• Set the direction for the NextGenSAP Programme Management Office, establishing clear governance, decision-making and accountability between the programme office and lines of business.

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 5–10 colleagues, including specialists and senior managers, creating an environment of clear priorities, collaboration and accountability.

• Take ownership of the programme budget and financial transparency, ensuring delivery within the agreed financial framework and relevant planning deadlines.

• Drive alignment among senior leaders on scope, cost, schedules and risk across a network of significant and interdependent projects, bringing clarity to critical decisions and trade-offs.

• Partner closely with the IT  to create an effective and integrated PMO, ensuring disciplined execution across the programme.

• Lead the programme’s change, communication and engagement strategy

Who you’ll work with

You will lead the NextGenSAP PMO team and work closely with the IT. Your key partners will include senior leaders and programme colleagues across Enterprise IT, HR, Global Manufacturing, R&D and Finance.

The NextGenSAP PMO is part of Digital Finance Processes within Finance Operations & GBS. The team combines strong financial expertise with a deep understanding of the business to strengthen the data foundations and infrastructure available to stakeholders.

With broad organisational and geographical reach, this is a role in which your ability to build trusted relationships and create alignment across functions, levels and borders will be central to your impact.

The position is based at Novo Nordisk headquarters in Bagsværd.

What you can expect here

You can expect a substantial Director leadership mandate with direct influence on a significant digital transformation programme. You will have the opportunity to shape how the programme is governed and executed, lead and develop an experienced team, and work closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation.

The scale and complexity of the programme will give you the opportunity to apply both strategic leadership and sound judgement, while remaining close enough to execution to turn decisions into meaningful progress.

What we offer

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy. here.

Start now

Your impact begins today.

If you are ready to bring clarity, governance and momentum to a major finance and operations transformation, apply for the Director, NextGenSAP Programme Management Office role by 15. November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Do you want to keep projects on track through effective coordination and high-quality documentation? Can you combine attention to detail with an overview of tasks, processes and deadlines? And do you have experience supporting project managers? Then join COWI as our new Project Coordinator!

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

jobs.description:

Lead WTW’s Nordic Global Benefits Management business within Integrated & Global Solutions. WTW combines data, insight and expertise to create solutions across people, risk and capital.

Combine hands-on software development with team leadership and make a real impact on cybersecurity and global security

Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with team leadership and have a direct influence on the architecture and evolution of mission-critical products?

This is your opportunity to make a difference.

Our client, Arbit Cyber Defence Systems, is growing rapidly and is looking for a dedicated Software Development Team Lead to join its R&D department in Hvidovre, just outside Copenhagen.

In this key role, you will lead a team of software engineers while remaining close to the code, the architecture and the technology. You will take ownership of software releases, Linux systems and development processes, helping ensure that your team delivers robust, high-quality software that meets the highest standards of security and performance.

If you are ready to combine technical depth with people leadership and contribute to protecting critical networks and sensitive information across borders, this could be your next career move.

About Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Arbit develops high-end network protection solutions for an international customer base, including intelligence agencies, armed forces and national governments. Its certified Cross Domain Solutions, including Data Diodes and TRUST Gateways, enable secure data transfer between networks operating at different security classification levels. With customers operating in some of the world’s most demanding security environments, Arbit plays an important role in protecting sensitive information and securing critical digital infrastructure across national borders.

Arbit’s R&D department brings together two development teams—Release and Project—alongside project management, hardware engineering and quality assurance specialists. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative environment where technical excellence, innovation and reliability are essential.

The role: Technical leadership with real influence

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead the Release development team, taking responsibility for its technical direction, delivery and people development. You will work closely with the CTO on technical decisions and development planning, helping translate product ambitions into robust, well-engineered solutions.

You will balance hands-on engineering with leadership, ensuring that your team has the direction, structure and support it needs to succeed.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership & Software Development

• Combine hands-on software development with responsibility for the architecture, design and continuous improvement of Arbit’s core products.

• Develop high-performance software components for unidirectional data transfer, with a strong focus on security, reliability and maintainability.

Release Management & Linux Systems

• Own software releases, ensuring efficient development processes, reliable CI/CD pipelines and delivery of high-quality software on time.

• Oversee Linux systems, make sure that a good infrastructure and hardware/software integration is built.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, motivate and develop your team, creating a positive environment where people thrive, grow their skills and deliver their best work.

• Set priorities, drive progress and represent the team within the organisation.

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with the CTO on technical decisions, architecture and development planning.

• Collaborate with Project Development, Quality Assurance, Service Delivery and Product Management to ensure thorough testing, smooth delivery and continued product innovation.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with a strong systems mindset and a genuine interest in leading people.

You understand that a single line of code can affect the security, reliability and performance of an entire hardware/software system. You enjoy diving into technical details, but you also know how to create clarity, set direction and bring out the best in a team.

You may already be an experienced Team Lead looking for a role with substantial technical depth—or a senior engineer who is ready to take the next step into formal leadership.

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, ideally including the development of a software product from the ground up through to production. Experience with Java and C++ is highly relevant.

• Leadership potential: Experience in team leadership and people management is an advantage. Alternatively, you may have mentored less experienced developers and be ready to take on your first formal leadership role.

• Strong systems understanding: A solid foundation in computer science, software architecture and system design, ideally complemented by knowledge of relevant standards and compliance requirements.

• Linux expertise: Practical experience with Linux system management and a good understanding of system integration, build environments and release infrastructure.

• A structured, proactive approach: You create momentum, establish clear priorities and take ownership of progress and results.

• A collaborative mindset: You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships and enjoy working across disciplines.

• Relevant education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Language skills: Fluency in English is essential. If you are not fluent in Danish, you should have a good understanding of the language.

Security clearance: Due to the nature of Arbit’s customers and products, you must be eligible to obtain and maintain a SECRET (HEMMELIGT) security clearance.

Why join Arbit?

• Make a difference: Develop advanced cybersecurity solutions for international clients and help protect critical networks and sensitive information.

• Shape technology and people: Influence core product development while leading a skilled team of engineers in a collaborative R&D environment.

• Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible working hours, the option to work from home, a pension scheme, healthcare, fitness facilities and team-building activities.

• A close-knit team: Join a growing company with more than 25 employees, an informal culture and a strong team spirit.

More about Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Founded in 2006, Arbit has established itself as a specialist in advanced cybersecurity solutions for highly sensitive environments. As the need to protect critical networks and information continues to grow, Arbit’s technology plays an increasingly important role.

Arbit is among a small number of companies worldwide whose products have achieved NATO COSMIC TOP SECRET and EU TOP SECRET accreditation.

Learn more at arbitcds.com.

Are you interested in joining Arbit?

Please do not hesitate to apply for the position by sending your CV and a short application. If you have questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!
